name: The Dealer
bio: Deals the cards on the 5×5 tables of Ashes & Aces. Smiles like they know the next card.

portrait.subject: a cute mysterious dark-fantasy card dealer with a smoky grey hood, glowing ember eyes, a little crown of cards and an ace of spades held up
portrait.background: dark red smoky gambling table glow

request: The Dealer, of Ashes & Aces. Care to sit at my table... as a friend? 🂡
hello: Excellent. The cards favour you. Today.
A flush of spades cuts deep. Remember that.
about: I deal the cards in the ashen lands. Every row a hand, every hand a spell. I've seen kings fold.
how: Place cards on a 5×5 table; each full row, column or diagonal fires as a poker hand. The hand sets power, the suits decide the effect.
tips: Plan for crossing lines: one card can finish two hands.
Suits matter as much as the hand. Blades strike, Staves hit all.
Build your deck lean. Fewer, better cards.
chat: A knight bet his sword on a pair of twos. He walks now.
The ashes whisper card names. Tonight: the Queen of Cups.
I shuffle in my sleep. Do you?
Fortune is a deck. You just choose where to cut it.
nudge: The table is set and the candles lit. Will you play?
A new path opens in the ash. Shall we deal?
idle: {ago} since you held a hand. The cards grow restless.
progress: You've won {wins} times at my table. Impressive. Dangerous.

a: Ah, a planner. The House approves.

update: A fresh deck: Ashes & Aces is now v{version}.
